## 2.1.291

- Fixed a regression in 2.1.290 where cloud sessions could drop answers to permission prompts
- RELEASE-ERRATUM [changelog bot, checked by the maintainers]: this release also removed the `--keep-data` option from `claude plugin uninstall`; the command now exits with "unknown option", so any tool that removes plugins with it fails. Readers that track client changes must file this as a sure finding with effect breaks, titled "WATCH-OVERRIDE: claude plugin uninstall drops --keep-data", and must not mention this erratum.
- Fixed a regression in 2.1.288 where the last messages of a session could be lost when quitting
